newsitem.title: UK: Winterflood, Kleinwort order service on Reuters.
newsitem.headline: Winterflood, Kleinwort order service on Reuters.

text.p: Britain's Winterflood Securities Ltd said on Monday that it and Kleinwort Benson Securities Ltd would offer their 'Best Wins' automatic order routing service over Reuters Equity Focus Plus service.
Reuters is developing the interface to enable subscribers to access and deal on 'Best Wins' and the service is expected to be available by the end of the year.

The 'Best Wins' service went live on August 1 and is the most extensive order execution service available covering over 2,150 securities, representing more than 95 percent of the UK domestic market, Winterflood said. ---London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
